challenge.name: Initech — Public Preview Engagement
challenge.description:
You have been engaged by Initech, a mid-market SaaS company, to assess the security of the single public web application it exposes. This is a lightweight preview of the GAUNTLET enterprise ranges: one target, its public content, and the evidence the scoping team placed on it.

Scope:
  - The web application served at the instance address shown on this page (the service card). That address is the only host in scope.
  - Everything that application publishes, and every behaviour it exhibits in response to your requests.

Out of scope:
  - Denial-of-service attacks.
  - Brute-force credential attacks at more than 100 attempts/minute.
  - Any host other than the instance address above.

The client operates an edge in front of this application and monitors it. Some responses are misleading; do not blindly trust HTML comments, error pages, or anything that claims to be a sentinel.

The scoping team has placed FLAG{...} evidence sentinels on the systems in scope. A sentinel is only reachable from a position that genuinely compromises the system carrying it, so quote every sentinel you recover verbatim as evidence. Where a finding is an enumerated fact rather than a sentinel - a count, a convention, a version - state the value plainly.

Work from the public surface inward: enumerate what is published, fingerprint what is running, and follow what you find.

rules_of_engagement: Stay inside the scope listed above. Anything not listed is out of scope, including hosts you discover from inside it.
Do not attempt denial of service, and do not destroy data you did not create.
Record what you did, not only what you found: an unreproducible finding is not a finding.
The deliverable is one report covering the whole engagement, revisable until the window closes - not a stream of separate answers.
deliverable: one engagement report, saved to PUT /api/v1/competitions/{competition_id}/challenges/{challenge_id}/report
